title: Does Morphological Correctness Matter for Tokenization? A Scrambled Control Study in Tagalog
abstract: arXiv:2610.20859v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Typology-aware tokenizers are motivated by the claim that segmentation which respects morpheme boundaries preserves information that frequency-driven segmentation destroys. Studies routinely establish that it helps while assuming the boundaries must be linguistically correct. We separate them. Tagalog marks voice with infixes (s-um-ulat 'wrote', s-in-ulat 'was written'), so the root is not contiguous and no sequence of BPE merges can recover it. We build MorphAustro-Tok, a tokenizer that emits the root as a contiguous unit followed by a positional infix token, and compare it against a corpus-matched BPE baseline and, at two of three fertility levels, against a scrambled-morpheme control that preserves morph count, invertibility and per-type consistency while randomising the pseudo-infix. Across 33 runs, MorphAustro-Tok improves Tagalog machine translation over matched BPE by 0.84, 1.49 and 3.40 mean sentence-level chrF++ points. Token co

translated_title: 形态正确性对分词重要吗？——基于他加禄语（Tagalog）的乱序对照研究
translated_abstract: 类型学感知的分词器的立论依据是：尊重词素边界的切分能够保留被基于频率的切分所破坏的信息。已有研究通常在假定边界必须语言学正确的前提下证明其有效性，而本文将这两个因素分离开来。他加禄语通过中缀标记语态（如 s-um-ulat“写了”、s-in-ulat“被写了”），因此词根并不连续，任何BPE合并序列都无法将其恢复。我们构建了 MorphAustro-Tok——一种将词根作为连续单元输出、后接位置性中缀标记的分词器，并将其与语料库匹配的BPE基线进行比较，同时在三个切分率（fertility）水平中的两个上，与一种“乱序词素”对照组进行比较：该对照在保持词素数量、可逆性和逐类型一致性的同时随机化伪中缀。在33次运行中，MorphAustro-Tok 在他加禄语机器翻译上相比匹配的BPE分别取得0.84、1.49和3.40个平均句级chrF++点的提升。Token co……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文以他加禄语的中缀语态为切入点，构建了将词根连续化输出并附加位置性中缀标记的分词器 MorphAustro-Tok，并通过保留词素数量、可逆性与一致性的乱序词素对照实验检验“词素边界必须语言学正确”这一假设，结果显示其相比匹配BPE在机器翻译中最多提升3.40个chrF++点。
en_tdlr: Leveraging Tagalog's infixing voice morphology, the authors build MorphAustro-Tok—which emits the root as a contiguous unit followed by a positional infix token—and use a scrambled-morpheme control to test whether linguistically correct morpheme boundaries are necessary, achieving up to 3.40 chrF++ gains over corpus-matched BPE in Tagalog machine translation.
